title: About
text:
I’m Dominique J. Strong, an analytics leader with 7+ years of experience using data, business intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modeling to improve customer retention, operational performance, and executive decision-making.
My background spans membership analytics, product analytics, operations risk, facilities analytics, and machine learning. I specialize in turning complex business problems into clear analytical frameworks, dashboards, KPIs, and models that help leaders act with confidence.
I currently work in Membership & Sales Analytics at AAA Mountain West Group, where I analyze large-scale customer lifecycle data across 6M+ members, build churn forecasting models, evaluate retention campaigns, and deliver executive-ready insights through Tableau, SQL, and Python.

title: About
text:
Analytics Philosophy
I believe analytics should do more than describe what happened. It should help organizations decide what to do next.
My approach combines:


Business Framing
Start with the decision, risk, opportunity, or KPI that matters most.


Technical Execution
Use SQL, Python, Tableau, statistics, and machine learning to build reliable analysis.


Executive Storytelling
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations leaders can act on.
